question:
Select the most appropriate options to fill in the blanks.

Microprocessor 8085 has ________ address line, hence it can access ________ of the memory.
solution:
The correct answer is __16; 64 kilobytes**(Option 4)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 8085 microprocessor__ has 16 address lines.
 
• With 16 address lines, the processor can address 2¹⁶ = 65,536 memory locations, which is equivalent to 64 kilobytes.
 
• The memory is organized in such a way that each address corresponds to 1 byte of memory.
 
• This allows the 8085 microprocessor to access up to 64 KB of memory directly.
 
• This addressing capability is one of the defining features of the 8085 architecture.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Microprocessor 8085**:
 
 
• It is an 8-bit microprocessor, meaning it can process 8 bits of data simultaneously.
 
• The 8085 operates on a +5V power supply and has a clock speed of up to 3 MHz.
 
 
 
• **Address Lines:**
 
 
• The number of address lines determines the maximum memory that can be addressed by the microprocessor.
 
• For the 8085, 16 address lines allow addressing up to 64 KB of memory space.
 
 
 
• **Data Lines:**
 
 
• The 8085 microprocessor has 8 data lines, allowing 8 bits of data to be transferred simultaneously.
